properties.name: Silke's House
properties.notes:
Mary Silke was born on 8/10/1869 and she is said to have been a kind of "Bean Feasa".

She is said to have been well connected with hares and there are always hare's in the field where the house is. We were told a story about a man from Barratoor who was passing called into Mary Silke's house looking for a light of his pipe but sitting in front of the fire instead of Mary Silke was a big hare. That finished the light!

It was also said that when people from this area would go to Biddy Early she would ask them why they came to her when they have a woman as good as her beside them. This is very unlikely to be true given that Mary Silke was 5 when Biddy Early died in 1874.

Mary Silke died on 17/02/1929.
